subject: VentureConf badge CSV — offline batch reconciliation & enrichment
messages:
From: Samantha Lopez <samantha.lopez@ventureconf.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: VentureConf Ops <ops@ventureconf.com>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: VentureConf badge CSV: offline upload + consent flags

Hi Evelyn / Ben,

We hit a connectivity outage on Saturday during the afternoon session and the handheld scanners defaulted to offline mode. We have an export from the devices with ~492 rows (attached) — badge_id, timestamp, phone, sometimes email, and a locally captured opt_in flag.

Ask: can Redwood help reconcile this batch so we can ingest into HubSpot without creating duplicates, and enrich missing emails where possible? Specifics:
- A subset (~120 rows) has only phone numbers and no email; some phones are shared (company booths).
- Offline opt_in values are booleans but our legal team wants consent recorded verbatim ("I agree to receive communications about products and events").
- We also need to preserve badge_id for provenance so Customer Success can trace source.

Attached: ventureconf_offline_batch_05092027.csv (csv)

Timeline: we'd like a canary import into a test HubSpot workspace by Monday morning Pacific.

Thanks — Samantha
Samantha Lopez
Events Manager, VentureConf
---
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lopez <samantha.lopez@ventureconf.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: VentureConf badge CSV: offline upload + consent flags

Hi Samantha — thanks for the file and context. We can handle this. Proposed plan (short):

1) Schema validation: we will map your CSV to our import template (attached: batch_mapping_template.csv). Please confirm column mapping for badge_id and opt_in_text.

2) Deduping strategy: primary keys: badge_id -> phone -> email (if present). We will dedupe by badge_id first, then merge on phone/email. If there is a conflict, we will create a single lead with multiple phone records and preserve original badge_id as a custom property (ventureconf_badge_id).

3) Enrichment pass: for rows missing email we will attempt enrichment via third-party (Clearbit/FullContact) limited to company email resolution. We will only enrich if there is a firmographic match to avoid false positives.

4) Consent handling: we will populate HubSpot contact property "ventureconf_consent_text" with the verbatim text you provided. For any rows where opt_in=false we will set lifecycle_stage=unsubscribed and add a notice in the notes. Please confirm the exact consent language you need recorded — attached: consent_text_v1.txt is our suggested canonical wording.

5) Sandbox canary: we will run an import of 50 records into our sandbox HubSpot account and share the report. Once you confirm, we will proceed with full import.

6) Post-import logs: we will provide a reconciliation CSV with mapping decisions and a mapping of original badge_id -> HubSpot contact ID.

7) Fallback / future-proofing: we recommend enabling the real-time webhook fallback for devices so offline batches are queued to S3 and pushed to Redwood's ingestion API. I can have Sean share our webhook spec.

Estimated ETA: canary results by Monday 10:00am PT (48 hours from now).

Attachments: batch_mapping_template.csv, consent_text_v1.txt

If that all looks good I will start the validation pass now.

—Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Head of Field Partnerships, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: VentureConf badge CSV: offline upload + consent flags

Quick notes from ops side — agreed with Evelyn's plan. A couple operational items to lock: 
- HubSpot import field names we will use: "email", "phone", "ventureconf_badge_id", "ventureconf_consent_text", "lead_source" (set to "VentureConf - badge"), "lifecycle_stage".
- Ensure SFDC connector will not create duplicate accounts — map HubSpot dedupe key to email/phone and set sync rule to "contact wins" for merges during this import window.
- Can we drop a sandbox import file with 50 rows flagged as "canary=true" so CS can validate UX in the CRM?

I'll loop Sean to give the webhook spec and confirm the enrichment provider toggles (we should avoid bulk enrichment for any contacts marked "opt_in=false").

—Ben
Ben Carter

Thanks — looking forward to the reconciliation report.
